Title: Users may be unable to open the SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive file picker in Agent Builder within Microsoft Copilot

User impact: Users may be unable to open the SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive file picker in Agent Builder within Microsoft Copilot.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Copilot and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to open the SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive file picker in Agent Builder within Microsoft Copilot

User impact: Users may be unable to open the SharePoint and Microsoft OneDrive file picker in Agent Builder within Microsoft Copilot.

More info: Specifically, opening the SharePoint and OneDrive file picker to add knowledge fails with the following message: 
"Failed to authenticate. Please try again."

To bypass impact, users may go to Knowledge, then Add knowledge, paste the SharePoint and OneDrive file or site URL into the search box instead of using the cloud picker.

Current status: We've identified that a recent update to the Microsoft 365 Copilot app changed how it handles SharePoint and OneDrive sign-in requests and is causing the affected requests to be passed to the app in an older format, resulting in authentication failures when users open the cloud file picker to add knowledge. We're deploying a code fix that we've developed and we estimate that it'll complete deployment by our next scheduled communications update.

Scope of impact: Users located in Europe, United State, and Japan attempting to open the SharePoint Online and OneDrive file picker in Agent Builder within Microsoft Copilot may be impacted by this event. This section may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 2:22 AM UTC

Root cause: A recent update to the Microsoft 365 Copilot app changed how it handles SharePoint and OneDrive sign-in requests and is causing the affected requests to be passed to the app in an older format, resulting in authentication failures when users open the cloud file picker to add knowledge.

Next update by: Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 8:00 PM UTC
